experiment: T1 determinism control: MP_EN off, nothing else changed

source_patch.what: opt-in -DNO_MP=ON; the two '#ifdef MP_EN' parallel loops become '#if defined(MP_EN) && !defined(NO_MP)'; one startup ROS_INFO line reporting MP_EN/MP_PROC_NUM/omp_get_max_threads(). Nothing else: rate, config, prefix, bag and runner unchanged.

runs: cell O, two runs, same bag/runner/prefix/config; only MP_EN differs from the archived runs

criterion.declared: if both runs land on the same mode AND the aligned first-pose difference is < 0.05 m, S1 (OpenMP reduction order) is accepted as the main seed; otherwise go to T2 (taskset + nice + idle machine)
criterion.first_pose_alignment: single SE(3) fitted on the common healthy prefix, then compare the first output pose of the two runs

thresholds.same_mode: both GOOD or both BAD by the unsupported rule (<0.10 / >0.50)

expected_records: binary sha in the run receipt
